summary: AWS CLI checks, installation, updates, and SSO browser authentication.

commons.summary: AWS CLI common helpers for CLI availability, version output, caller identity checks, and identity diagnostics.

auth.summary: AWS SSO browser authentication command implementation.

install.summary: AWS CLI v2 installation command implementation.

update.summary: AWS CLI v2 update command implementation.

auth.summary: Starts AWS SSO browser authentication or SSO profile configuration and validates caller identity when possible.

options.--profile: AWS profile to authenticate. Defaults to default.
options.--configure: Run aws configure sso instead of aws sso login.
options.--dry-run: Print the AWS SSO command without executing it.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: AWS CLI is missing outside dry-run.
The selected profile is not configured for SSO.
The user does not complete browser validation.
AWS CLI still cannot resolve caller identity after login.

check.summary: Checks AWS CLI availability and caller identity resolution for a profile.

options.--profile: AWS profile to inspect. Defaults to default.
options.--yes: Do not pause for the final acknowledgement prompt.
options.--verbose: Print AWS CLI configuration details when available.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: AWS CLI cannot resolve caller identity for the selected profile.

install.summary: Installs AWS CLI v2 with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print the official AWS CLI v2 install command without executing it, even if AWS CLI is already installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

supported_hosts.macos: Runs the official AWS CLI v2 install script for the current user.
supported_hosts.linux: Runs the official AWS CLI v2 install script for the current user.

expected_failure_when: The host operating system is unsupported.
The user declines the install prompt.
The AWS CLI install script fails.

update.summary: Updates AWS CLI v2 with explicit prompts.

options.--dry-run: Print aws update without executing it, even if AWS CLI is not installed.
options.--json: Append a compact machine-readable result object.

expected_failure_when: AWS CLI is missing outside dry-run.
The user declines the update prompt.
The AWS CLI update command fails.

notes: check is host-read-only and does not install, update, or authenticate AWS CLI.
auth mutates AWS CLI SSO credential cache or configuration and requires the user to complete browser validation.
install and update mutate the host and prompt unless --yes is provided.
install, update, and auth support --dry-run where command paths are printed but not executed.
dry-run must not short-circuit just because AWS CLI is already installed or currently missing.
No run command is currently defined because AWS CLI does not expose a durable local app process for this skill.
